web.overlay:
# GrigDesk overlay для штатного профиля web. Генерируется на каждый запуск.
- id: "settings"
  config:
    path: "<ROOT>/launch/native-settings.yaml"
- id: "sandbox-policy"
  config:
    mode: "workspace-write"
    workspaceRoot: "<ROOT>/project"
- id: "approval"
  config:
    policy: "ask"
- id: "permission"
  config:
    presets:
      read-only:
        sandbox: "read-only"
        approval: "ask"
      workspace-write:
        sandbox: "workspace-write"
        approval: "ask"
      danger-full-access:
        sandbox: "danger-full-access"
        approval: "never"
      factory-state-only:
        sandbox: "read-only"
        approval: "never"
      factory-workspace-write:
        sandbox: "workspace-write"
        approval: "never"
    defaultPreset: "workspace-write"
- id: "agent-instructions"
  config:
    maxBytes: 262144
- insert:
    - id: "hooks-claude-code"
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code"
      config:
        configPath: "<ROOT>/launch/hooks.json"
        projectDir: "<ROOT>/project/nested"
    - id: "grigdesk-mcp-fixture"
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"
      config:
        serverName: "fixture"
        transport: "stdio"
        command: "/usr/bin/fixture-mcp"
        args:
          - "--a"
          - "b"
        env:
          X: "y"

acp.overlay:
# GrigDesk overlay для штатного профиля acp. Генерируется на каждый запуск.
- id: "sandbox-policy"
  config:
    mode: "read-only"
    workspaceRoot: "<ROOT>/project"
- id: "approval"
  config:
    policy: "never"
- id: "permission"
  config:
    presets:
      read-only:
        sandbox: "read-only"
        approval: "ask"
      workspace-write:

        approval: "ask"
      danger-full-access:

        approval: "never"
      factory-state-only:
        sandbox: "read-only"
        approval: "never"

- id: "web"

- insert:
